subject.title: fix(qqbot): render safe exec approval previews

question: Should this PR require redacted QQ Desktop after-fix proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate for this deterministic renderer change?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot mark real behavior proof sufficient from unit tests alone, but the contributor says they cannot access QQ Desktop and the remaining choice is whether maintainers will own that client-rendering assumption.

options.title: Keep the proof gate
options.body: Wait for a redacted QQ Desktop screenshot or recording that shows a long exec approval wrapping after the fix before merge.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the QQ Desktop client assumption because the code path is a deterministic string transform covered by focused tests.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: If nobody can provide proof or own an override, leave the PR paused until the linked bug can be verified on a real client.

recommendation.title: Keep the proof gate
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted QQ Desktop screenshot or recording that shows a long exec approval wrapping after the fix before merge.
